evidence: Empirical comparison of two frozen models with individual laboratory crystals (mass and axes) and with the published fall-speed relation; no parameter is fitted or changed.

rule.axes_mapping: model spheroid full axes against measured full axes
rule.speed_reference: Takahashi et al. (1991) Table 4, each line the average of about four sets; stated accuracy 3 cm/s; individual speeds are not archived

limits: Repeat crystals within 0.5 C of a nominal temperature include that temperature spread.
Pooled scatter assumes similar relative spread at every age and temperature; the per-temperature sensitivity is recorded.
Thin planar thickness was inferred from mass and basal area by the authors and is absent per crystal.
Fall speed is compared with fitted averages, so crystal-to-crystal speed scatter is not tested.
The laboratory crystals grew at water saturation for at most 30 minutes at Earth gravity and pressure.
